name: Tenbinza Rararibu
source:
Sociable and skilled, the Prince of Libra can handle anything with ease.

He’s a genius at reading the room and good at getting things done. He’s got charm and charisma that make him very popular. He wants to be seen as a good person who lives up to his high ideals, and he works hard to achieve this. But though he seems perfect at first glance, he is actually short-tempered, sarcastic, and irritable. He is lazy at heart and tends to push his work onto others.
